name: The Winter Spiti Spell
hook: Snow landscapes, ancient monasteries and the quiet edge of the Himalayas.
route: Delhi → Shimla → Sangla → Chitkul → Kalpa → Nako → Tabo → Dhankar → Key Monastery → Chicham → Kaza → Hikkim → Komic → Langza → Kalpa → Shimla → Delhi
style: Winter Adventure · Snow Landscapes · Monasteries · Remote Himalayan Villages
durationNote: 7 days / 6 accommodation nights. The overnight return Volvo leaves Shimla on Day 7 and reaches Delhi on the morning of Day 8. The outbound Delhi-to-Shimla Volvo may depart the previous evening; allow for this additional travel time.
imageNote: AI-generated Himalayan illustrations are used for atmosphere, not as photographs of confirmed hotels, exact monuments or guaranteed snow conditions.
about: Travel from Delhi into the winter landscapes of Kinnaur and Spiti: Sangla's valley, Chitkul's traditional houses, Kalpa's mountain horizons and the monasteries and remote villages beyond Nako. A road journey through vast, quiet Himalayan country, with each day shaped by winter conditions.
closing: Leave with mountain stories. Carry the quiet home.
priceNote: Prices per person: INR 22,999 for Triple Sharing; INR 24,999 for Double Sharing. Dates TBA. Tax treatment, deposit, cancellation terms and final package inclusions/exclusions will be confirmed before booking. Applications are not open yet; no payment is requested.
mealNote: Day 1: meals as per package, to be confirmed. Days 2-6: Breakfast & Dinner. Day 7: Breakfast. No meals are specified for Day 8 or the Volvo journeys.
winterNote: Winter Spiti is highly weather-dependent. Road conditions, snowfall, temporary closures and travel timings can change based on local weather and administration. The final movement plan may therefore be adjusted only for safety and road accessibility, while keeping the planned destinations and route sequence wherever feasible.
stayNote: Six accommodation nights are planned in hotels, homestays or guesthouses as listed. Properties and facilities are not yet confirmed. The overnight return Volvo on Day 7 is additional to the six accommodation nights.
transportNote: Delhi - Shimla and Shimla - Delhi by Volvo Bus; the mountain circuit by Tempo Traveller. Exact pickup point, reporting time, bus schedule and vehicle arrangements will be shared with the confirmed departure. The outbound Volvo may leave Delhi the previous evening.
inclusionNote: The itinerary specifies the transport, six accommodation nights and meals shown here. Final package inclusions, exclusions, entry charges and any additional costs are still to be confirmed; no unspecified activity or service is promised as included.

highlights.title: Winter Spiti Valley
highlights.body: Experience snow landscapes and spectacular Kinnaur and Spiti views, conditions permitting.

highlights.title: Remote Himalayan villages
highlights.body: Explore Sangla Valley, Chitkul, Nako, Hikkim, Komic and Langza.

highlights.title: Three monastery chapters
highlights.body: Visit the historic Tabo, dramatic Dhankar and iconic Key Monasteries.

highlights.title: Hikkim Post Office
highlights.body: Visit Hikkim's iconic high-altitude post office, subject to local opening.

highlights.title: Komic & Langza
highlights.body: Motorable high-altitude villages, Langza's Buddha statue and vast mountain horizons.

highlights.title: Delhi to Delhi
highlights.body: Volvo journeys between Delhi and Shimla, with a Tempo Traveller for the mountain circuit.

days.title: Delhi → Shimla → Sangla
days.intro: Delhi to Shimla by Volvo. Shimla to Sangla by Tempo Traveller.

points.title: DELHI TO SHIMLA
points.body: Begin with an overnight / early-morning Volvo bus to Shimla.

points.title: MEET THE TRIP TEAM
points.body: On reaching Shimla, meet the team and board the Tempo Traveller.

points.title: THE MOUNTAIN JOURNEY
points.body: Drive towards Sangla through Himalayan roads, river valleys and winter scenery.

points.title: ARRIVE IN SANGLA
points.body: Check into your hotel / homestay and relax after the journey.

days.note: The outbound Volvo may leave Delhi the previous evening. Exact reporting time and Day 1 meals will be confirmed.

days.title: Sangla → Chitkul → Kalpa
days.intro: Traditional villages, the Baspa Valley and the Kinnaur Himalayas.

points.title: MORNING IN CHITKUL
points.body: Drive to Chitkul, a last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibetan border.

points.title: BASPA VALLEY
points.body: Explore traditional houses, mountain views and the winter landscape.

points.title: RAKCHAM & KALPA
points.body: Visit Rakcham along the route, continue to Kalpa and check in.

points.title: MARKET, MONASTERY & TEMPLES
points.body: Explore Homa Market, Kalpa Monastery, Kalpa Temple and Nagnarayani Temple.

points.title: KINNER KAILASH SUNSET
points.body: Enjoy views of the Kinnaur Himalayas and Kinner Kailash range around sunset.

days.note: Village access and visits remain subject to winter road conditions.

days.title: Kalpa → Nako → Tabo
days.intro: Leave Kinnaur's horizons for the stark winter landscapes of Spiti.

points.title: BREAKFAST & DEPARTURE
points.body: After breakfast, begin the mountain journey towards Spiti Valley.

points.title: KHAB SANGAM
points.body: Reach Khab, where the Sutlej and Spiti Rivers meet.

points.title: NAKO VILLAGE
points.body: Continue to high-altitude Nako and explore its winter surroundings.

points.title: ARRIVE IN TABO
points.body: Proceed into Spiti to Tabo, check in and rest after the long drive.

days.note: Travel times and short stops depend on road and weather conditions.

days.title: Tabo → Dhankar → Key Monastery → Chicham → Kaza
days.intro: Monasteries, high-altitude villages and the heart of Spiti.

points.title: TABO MONASTERY
points.body: Begin at historic Tabo Monastery, an important Buddhist centre in Spiti.

points.title: DHANKAR MONASTERY
points.body: Visit Dhankar Monastery, dramatically situated above the valley.

points.title: KEY MONASTERY
points.body: Continue to one of Spiti Valley's most iconic monasteries.

points.title: CHICHAM
points.body: Travel onwards to Chicham for spectacular high-altitude mountain scenery.

points.title: ARRIVE IN KAZA
points.body: Reach Kaza, Spiti's main town and administrative centre; check in and relax.

days.note: Monastery visits and the movement plan depend on local access and winter conditions.

days.title: Kaza Local Sightseeing
days.intro: A day among the remote villages and vast horizons of central Spiti.

points.title: HIKKIM POST OFFICE
points.body: After breakfast, visit Hikkim's high-altitude village and iconic post office.

points.title: KOMIC
points.body: Explore one of the world's highest motorable villages and its stark landscapes.

points.title: LANGZA
points.body: See the giant Buddha statue, traditional houses and the village's fossil-rich landscape.

points.title: WINTER PHOTOGRAPHY
points.body: Enjoy mountain views, photography and village exploration before returning to Kaza.

points.title: EVENING AT LEISURE
points.body: Relax in Kaza, explore the local market or spend time with the group.

days.note: Village roads and the post office are subject to local access and opening.

days.title: Kaza → Kalpa
days.intro: Retrace the spectacular route through dramatic valleys and mountain landscapes.

points.title: AN EARLY START
points.body: Set off early from Kaza for the return journey to Kalpa.

points.title: THE SPITI-KINNAUR ROUTE
points.body: Travel back through the valleys and mountain landscapes encountered earlier.

points.title: PHOTO STOPS
points.body: Take short photo stops where road and weather conditions allow.

points.title: EVENING IN KALPA
points.body: Arrive by evening, check in and enjoy Kalpa's peaceful winter atmosphere.

days.note: Arrival time can change with winter conditions.

days.title: Kalpa → Shimla → Delhi
days.intro: Return to Shimla and board the evening Volvo to Delhi.

points.title: BREAKFAST & FINAL MOUNTAIN DRIVE
points.body: After breakfast, begin the road journey from Kalpa to Shimla.

points.title: CHANGING HIMALAYAN LANDSCAPES
points.body: Enjoy the changing mountain scenery as you descend towards Shimla.

points.title: SHIMLA BUS STAND
points.body: Reach Shimla by evening and transfer to the return Volvo at the bus stand.

points.title: OVERNIGHT VOLVO TO DELHI
points.body: Board the bus for the overnight journey; Delhi arrival is on Day 8.

days.note: This bus night is additional to the six accommodation nights. Road and bus timings may change.

days.title: Arrive in Delhi
days.intro: Arrive in Delhi in the morning, marking the end of your Winter Spiti Valley adventure.

points.title: MORNING ARRIVAL
points.body: Arrive in Delhi after the overnight Volvo journey.

points.title: TRIP ENDS - DELHI
points.body: Thank you for travelling with us!

days.note: Keep onward travel flexible until the confirmed bus schedule is shared. END OF THE SPELL.
